Codex chooses native pixel art, motion bounds, shell opacity and larger existing model scale. Broader pasted overhaul remains context. Latest user explicitly rejects smooth spherical meshes and requires voxel/cuboid-stacked segmented hemisphere, crisp pixel art, warm gold/amber/ivory and additive or alpha-test. Latest subsequent user steering rejects clipping flat tile grid and explicitly permits a proper curved hemisphere or cohesive solid model, requiring correct face orientation, smooth shading, UV continuity and player scale. This supersedes the separate cuboid-plaque restriction. Codex chooses a connected194-vertex thick shell and additive whole-surface gold-wave material.
